verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אַ֭שְׁרֵי כָּל־ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝הֹלֵ֗ךְ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’aš·rê kāl- yə·rê Yah·weh ha·hō·lêḵ biḏ·rā·ḵāw
verses.literal: A song of ascents Blessed are all who fear the LORD who walk in His ways
verses.literalPt: Feliz é todo aquele que teme a Jeová, que anda nos seus caminhos.

verses.original: יְגִ֣יעַ כַּ֭פֶּיךָ כִּ֣י תֹאכֵ֑ל אַ֝שְׁרֶ֗יךָ וְט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḡî·a‘ kap·pe·ḵā kî ṯō·ḵêl ’aš·re·ḵā wə·ṭō·wḇ lāḵ
verses.literal: For when you eat the fruit of your labor blessings and prosperity will be yours
verses.literalPt: Pois comerás do trabalho das tuas mãos; feliz serás, e te irá bem.

verses.original: אֶשְׁתְּךָ֤׀ כְּגֶ֥פֶן פֹּרִיָּה֮ בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֪י בֵ֫יתֶ֥ךָ בָּ֭נֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵ֣י זֵיתִ֑ים סָ֝בִ֗יב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eš·tə·ḵā kə·ḡe·p̄en pō·rî·yāh bə·yar·kə·ṯê ḇê·ṯe·ḵā bā·ne·ḵā kiš·ṯi·lê zê·ṯîm sā·ḇîḇ lə·šul·ḥā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table
verses.literalPt: Tua mulher será como videira frutífera, no interior de tua casa; teus filhos, como plantas de oliveira, à roda da tua mesa.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה כִי־ כֵ֭ן יְבֹ֥רַךְ גָּ֗בֶר יְרֵ֣א יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḵî- ḵên yə·ḇō·raḵ gā·ḇer yə·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: In this way indeed . . . shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eis que assim será abençoado o homem que teme a Jeová.

verses.original: יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהוָ֗ה מִצִּ֫יּ֥וֹן וּ֭רְאֵה בְּט֣וּב יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā Yah·weh miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn ū·rə·’êh bə·ṭūḇ yə·rū·šā·lim kōl yə·mê ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: May the LORD bless you from Zion that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life
verses.literalPt: De Sião te abençoará Jeová. E verás a prosperidade de Jerusalém todos os dias da tua vida.

verses.original: וּרְאֵֽה־ בָנִ֥ים לְבָנֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.literal: that you may see your children’s children Peace be upon Israel
verses.literalPt: Sim, verás os filhos de teus filhos. Que a paz seja sobre Israel!
